description: This file defines an Android activity 'AppHwConfigList' that displays a list of installed applications, allows the user to select one, and then possibly view or modify hardware configuration preferences related to the selected app.

classes.name: AppHwConfigList
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that displays installed apps and handles user interactions to view preferences.

classes.name: AppHwConfigList.AppListAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to manage and display the list of installed applications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, fetches package manager, sets up list adapter, and finishes if no apps are found.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Lifecycle method, currently just calls superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Lifecycle method, currently just calls superclass implementation.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles click events on list items, launches 'AppHwPref' activity passing the selected app's package name.

methods.name: appForPosition
methods.description: Returns the PackageInfo for the app at the given position in the list.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of apps in the list.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the list index; actual app data is retrieved via 'appForPosition'.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a list item view and binds app label to it.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds application label to the list item view.
